Preserve only existing work, including the security evidence matrix, private launch gates, and the slot-gated allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement after the existing saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case releases capacity. Revenue evidence supports only $4.92 aggregate unattributed commission for 2026-09-21; site revenue, margin, ROI, and causal lift remain unknown.

Complete or close the existing saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case with root cause, isolated validation, build checks, rollback point, and release-boundary evidence. Release one delivery slot only after that disposition is recorded. Do not admit duplicate work or prototypes.

Retain the existing fleet security evidence matrix and private launch gates. Do not create a duplicate security proposal or request telemetry already covered by the shared snapshot. Reassess only after dated authorized evidence or explicit unknowns are recorded for the required control areas.

Reviewer disposition: reject revenue, ROI, causal-lift, spend, credential/configuration, deployment, and external-outreach claims. Analytics is unavailable fleet-wide; Amazon evidence supports only $4.92 aggregate unattributed commission for 2026-09-21. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, so new work is slot-gated only.
